name: TRYAMM Faith World Community Expansion
releaseRule: Do not mark a capability LIVE without a verified production route or production-backed workflow.

Use shared trees, terrain, roads, water, boats, markets, dwellings, clothing, crowds, lighting and audio as reusable licensed or TRYAMM-created assets across chapters instead of rebuilding per scene.
Small-group study rooms, moderated discussions, LIVE classes, reading plans, service missions and ministry publishing require identity, moderation and community-safety controls.
Faith-linked stewardship missions should connect service, ecology, food, cleanup, conservation and community-impact learning without fabricating real-world impact claims.
Kingdoms Press provides editorial, rights, accessibility, translation, print/POD, HoloBook, royalty/sales and author-event workflows; provider-backed print submission remains gated.
